compute_character_error_rates: compute CER, IER, DER, SER metrics from predicted and target strings using CharacterErrorRates
convert_string_to_keys: convert a unicode string to a list of pynput key representations using CharacterSet str_to_keys
convert_string_to_labels: convert a unicode string to a list of categorical class labels using CharacterSet str_to_labels
decode_ctc_emissions_greedy: decode CTC emission probabilities into label sequences using CTCGreedyDecoder
clean_and_normalize_keys: normalize and filter a sequence of keys to only supported ones using CharacterSet clean_keys
